claimed.subject: Building private legal AI at Conqr
claimed.body:
Hi Conqr team,

The Software Engineer opening stood out because you're building for lawyers inside Word, Outlook and the browser, while keeping client documents in private environments. That mix of careful backend engineering and practical UI work is exactly what I enjoy.

At Stride.AI, I shipped full-stack features and backend APIs, including authentication shared across applications. I've also built Captar, an SDK for controlling LLM calls with policies, spending limits and tracing.

Would you consider my background for the India-remote Software Engineer role?

Portfolio: https://devansh.aurat.ai
GitHub: https://github.com/8dazo

Devansh
